paragraphs: Here's what I want you to hold onto, friend. The LORD said all that hard talk about an unfaithful people, and then He turned around and said He would "allure her" and "speak to her tenderly" (Hosea 2:14). He doesn't stay at the hard talk. He's the One who goes after His people, and He's the One who brings them back.

Then look at what He says He'll do with the worst places. The Valley of Achor, a place tied to trouble, becomes "a gateway of hope" (Hosea 2:15). Names like "No Compassion" and "Not My People" get turned around too, and He says, "You are My people," and they say, "You are my God" (Hosea 2:23). So whatever you're carrying that has your name on it, the LORD is not stuck on it.

And this is no short-term deal. He says, "I will betroth you to Me forever," in righteousness, justice, loving devotion, compassion and faithfulness (Hosea 2:19-20). Notice the result: "you will know the LORD" (Hosea 2:20). So if you've drifted, friend, you can come back to Him with your head up, because this promise is about what He says He will do.
